Arotech Corporation
Annual Report 2016
Nasdaq: ARTX

March 2017
Dear Fellow Shareholder,
Thank you for your support of Arotech. In 2016, we continued the transformation of our corporate cost
structure, and the commitment we have made to improving shareholder returns. The streamlining efforts we began in 2015 were continued during 2016. We exit 2016 as a much leaner company, and are
ready to capitalize on our many promising endeavors.
We were able to improve our bottom line from continuing operations in 2016, despite a 3.7% downturn
in revenues during the year. This was the result of cost cutting and segment margin improvement in our
Simulation Division.
We have a great capability set at Arotech, which is owing to our talented and dedicated staff. The
promising developments at both our Training and Simulation Division and our Power Systems Division
should lead to a bright future for Arotech. I look forward to better top and bottom line results and building a stronger backlog of orders as we realize in 2017 the results of the hard work we put in last year.
Once again, thank you for your support.
Sincerely,
Dean M. Krutty
Acting Chief Executive Officer
